h: רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ אִיָּר, ב׳ Rosh Chodesh Iyar, 2

p: "He made the letter vav king over thought...
and the right kidney in the soul..."
and so it is written regarding all the months.
which is the letter of truth,
for stray thought is one of the three things
from which no person is saved each day
meaning that even one who is careful about them,
a stray thought enters his heart
it is counted as a great thing in Yechezkel:
"that I did not entertain thoughts by day..."
even though it is a forbidden thing —
from which no person is saved...
And likewise the meaning of "iyun tefillah"
is that at times a stray thought falls in
He made king the letter vav,
which is the letter of truth,
one can be saved from stray thought.
And it says, "and the right kidney in the soul,"
and it stands to reason that the good one is at his right...
'The heart of the wise man is at his right...'"
For regarding the heart, too, it says,
"The heart of the wise man is at his right,
and the heart of the fool at his left" —
there is the dwelling place of the soul,
is the wisdom of the brain.
But in the kidneys we do not find
that there is a dwelling place for wisdom,
as stated in the Midrash (beginning of Mishlei):
Rabbi Eliezer said: in the head;
Rabbi Yehoshua said: in the heart..."
Only regarding the kidneys does it say "give counsel."
And this is as it says (Tehillim 51:8):
"Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts,
and in the hidden part You make me know wisdom";
and "the inward parts" are the kidneys.
And this is based on what is said
בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (סוֹף צַו, חֵלֶק ג לה, ב)
in the Zohar HaKadosh (end of Tzav, III 35b):
'And his name shall be called Wonder';
placed in the kidneys a "wondrous counselor"
from the primordial light, which is called "wonder,"
so that one can strengthen the right kidney,
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה צה, ג)
And this is what the Midrash says (Bereishis Rabbah 95:3)
that He placed wisdom in his heart or his brain,
and he attained all the words of Torah,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה מט, ב)
"At first, the secret of Hashem was for those who fear Him;
then, 'His secret is with the upright';
אַבְרָהָם זֶה יָשָׁר מִן הַיְשָׁרִים וְכוּלֵּי
Avraham is upright among the upright...
And so the work of this month,
in which the Holy One, blessed be He, made king
is to be able to strengthen the right kidney
to purify the thoughts of the heart.
and to ask, "Create for me a pure heart."
And yirah is in the heart,
עַל מִי שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
this is said of one who has no yiras Shamayim."
מַכְנִיס בּוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא קְדוּשָּׁה
the Holy One, blessed be He, brings holiness into him,
(in the Yehi Ratzon after Sefiras HaOmer):
"And I will be purified and sanctified
And this is the meaning of Sefirah.
And as we said (in the previous maamar),
based on what the Midrash says
"A joyful heart makes a good countenance,"
and joy belongs to the upright,
"and for the upright of heart, joy" (Taanis 15a).
And by attaining uprightness of heart,
The twelve months of the year
הֵם כְּנֶגֶד שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר שִׁבְטֵי יָהּ
correspond to the twelve tribes of Hashem
according to the order of the banners:
the month of Nissan corresponds to Yehudah,
And it is written (Divrei HaYamim I 12:33):
those who had understanding of the times" —
how to intercalate years and fix months
בְּסוֹד עַמִּי לֹא יִהְיוּ (יְחֶזְקֵאל יג, ט)
"'In the council of My people they shall not be' (Yechezkel 13:9) —
this is the secret of intercalation";
that they should not reveal the secret
to the nations of the world.
some say, the secret of intercalation,
and some say, the secret of the reasons of the Torah.
that they should not reveal the secret of intercalation,
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (דְּבָרִים ד, ו)
this is the secret of intercalation (Shabbos 75a).
רַבֵּינוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ זֵכֶר צַדִּיק וְקָדוֹשׁ לִבְרָכָה
our holy Rebbe, zecher tzaddik v'kadosh livrachah:
it is written "understanding of the times,"
for the understanding comes before the times.
that it is Shabbos and the like,
but if he were traveling in the wilderness
and did not know when Shabbos is,
he would not sense it at all.
that the time and the season
and for sanctifying the month on it.
about a moon seen at its proper time, in order to extend the month
that the holiness needed to be set on this day.
And this is the secret of intercalation.
At first, "the secret of Hashem was for those who fear Him"
one also attains uprightness of heart,
to straighten the crookedness of the heart."
Then, "His secret is with the upright" —
and he has already emptied the evil from the "heart of the fool";
corresponds to the holiness of Yissachar,
and the secret of intercalation is for the upright of heart,
and "for the upright of heart, joy,"
and "a joyful heart makes a good countenance" —
that is, the radiance of My children has come.
that one should merit to purify the thoughts of the heart
by making king the letter vav,
which is the letter of truth,
And the letter vav is the river
that "goes out of Eden to water the garden,"
drawing from the supernal wondrous light,
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קצג, ב)
And it is stated in the Zohar HaKadosh (III 193b):
for all the counsel of the prophets
And this is called in the Zohar HaKadosh
from which the prophets draw their nurture
(and so it is written in the Tikkunim,
at the beginning of the Introduction, 2b:
and they correspond to Moshe and Aharon.
The right kidney corresponds to Moshe,
who brought the Torah down from Heaven;
who is the "groomsman of the Matrona,"
and he is the root of the Oral Torah,
from "the heart of the fool at his left."
the right kidney, which counsels for good —
a person must make king the letter vav,
and Hashem Yisbarach will bring into him
